title: Fossil fuel importers face $330B cost surge amid US-Iran tensions: CREA
summary:

The post Fossil fuel importers face $330B cost surge amid US-Iran tensions: CREA appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Rising geopolitical tensions between the United States and Iran threaten to drive a massive cost surge for fossil fuel importers.
